data.content_ref: inline:SRC_002 and SRC_005 are compatible but distinct in scope: SRC_002 outlines the general inconsistency of Popper's position regarding action, while SRC_005 specifies the exact mechanism (uniformity of nature) by which the inconsistency occurs. REFUTED If SRC_002's claim of 'internal inconsistency' relies on premises other than the uniformity of nature, such as probabilistic definitions of verisimilitude, which would make SRC_005's specific mechanism insufficient to cover SRC_002's broader claim.
